sourceActivityMap.key: Original P(1,1),Q(3,1),R(2,3). T1 all (+3,+1) true; T4 all (-2,+2) true; T2 is half-turn about origin, T3 reflection across x=0; latter congruent but not pure translations.
Original A(1,1),B(4,1),C(4,3),D(1,3), U translate (-5,+2) -> (-4,3),(-1,3),(-1,5),(-4,5). V moves corresponding C to (-1,6), so B″C″ length3 versus original BC length2.
EFGH original (0,0),(3,0),(3,2),(1,3), M reflected across x=0 -> (0,0),(-3,0),(-3,2),(-1,3) congruent; N instead H″=(-1,1), so EH side changes √10 to √2, not congruent.
Four 1x1 tiles make 2x2 square area4 perimeter8 or 1x4 rectangle area4 perimeter10. Not congruent; a translated 2x2 copy is congruent via one translation.

boundary: Reflections are rigid and can preserve congruence while not being pure translations
